svg.title: 1. Spatial-frequency decomposition
svg.desc: At computed steps the transformer's velocity goes through an orthonormal 2D DCT, per channel, and the frequency plane is split into 7 radial bands from low to high frequency. Each coefficient is forecast as its own time series. At skipped steps each coefficient is forecast first, then the forecast goes through the inverse DCT and the forecast velocity goes to the sampler. The frequency plane shown is the log-magnitude 2D DCT of the luminance of one final generated image at 128 by 128, with the paper's radial band edges drawn on top and a zoom of the 12 by 12 lowest-frequency corner; it illustrates the band layout and is not the velocity. The velocity tiles are schematic.
svg.text: 2D DCT of the velocity, per channel
Each coefficient is forecast as its own time series
